transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… it’s my eating at night. Once I start, it feels like I’m watching myself do it and telling myself to stop, but my hands just keep going back for more.
Do you feel like you're in control while eating at night, or is it like your hands are moving on their own?
It doesn’t feel like I’m in control, no. I can sort of see myself doing it, telling myself to stop, but… I just keep reaching for more anyway.
Do you feel guilty or ashamed after these nighttime eating episodes?
I… don’t know. I don’t really like thinking about it after. I usually just try to move on.
Have you experienced any issues with your sex life recently?
I’d rather not get into that too much. I haven’t really noticed anything I’d call a problem.
Are you currently experiencing any difficulty with sexual arousal or pleasure?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been paying attention to that, and… I don’t think there’s anything specific I can say.
Have you noticed any decrease in your interest in sex?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed a decrease, exactly. It’s not something I’ve been focusing on much.
Have you experienced any difficulty becoming aroused during sexual activity?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear problem with that… it’s not something I’ve been paying close attention to.
Have you noticed a decrease in your desire to have sex?
I can’t really say I’ve noticed that, no. It’s just… not something I’ve been thinking much about.
Do you feel like you have less interest in sex than you used to?
I don’t think so… not in any way I’ve really noticed. It’s just not something I’ve been keeping track of.
Is this loss of control during eating something that only happens at night?
Mostly, yeah. It’s… once I start eating at night, I’ll be telling myself to stop, but I just keep reaching for more.
Does this loss of control during eating ever happen to you during the day?
Not really… I mean, it’s mainly at night. That’s when I start and then it’s like I’m watching myself keep going, even though I’m telling myself to stop.
Do you usually eat at night when you're alone?
Usually, yeah… I tend to be by myself. Once I start, it’s like I’m telling myself to stop, but I just keep going back for more.
Do you try to hide your nighttime eating from others?
I don’t know… I guess I don’t really talk about it. I’m usually alone anyway, so there isn’t much to hide.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating at night?
I’m not really sure… I don’t feel great about it, but I don’t know if I’d call it guilt exactly.
Do you make an effort to eat at night without others knowing about it?
I don’t know if I’d say I make an effort. It just… usually happens when no one’s around.
Do you eat at night in a way that you wouldn't want others to know about?
I’m not sure… I mean, I don’t exactly want people watching me eat like that, but I haven’t really thought of it as something I’m hiding.
Do you feel like you're eating quickly when this happens at night?
I don’t really know. I haven’t paid much attention to how fast I’m eating, honestly.
Do you find yourself eating a large amount of food in a short amount of time at night?
Yeah… sometimes. I’ll start with just leftovers, but then it turns into sandwiches, cereal, cookies… whatever’s around. It ends up being a lot more than I’d normally eat for supper.
Do you feel like you're eating quickly when this nighttime eating happens?
I still don’t really know. I’m not watching the clock or anything… I guess I’m just eating, and then it’s over.
Do you feel like you're eating quickly during these episodes at night?
I’m really not sure. It doesn’t feel like I’m rushing exactly… I just kind of go through it and don’t think about the speed.
